title: First Document Findings in Dresden, Germany
summary: The Department has completed the initial cataloguing of material recovered at Excavation Site 4. Further technical assessment is ongoing.

banner.caption: Archival material from the excavation is catalogued at the Department's facilities. Image: Department of ACTONA.

body: The Department has completed the initial cataloguing of all material recovered during the excavation at Site 4.
Recovered items have been registered under the departmental archival classification system and transferred to the holding facility for further assessment.
A review of the recovered material is currently in progress. The Department will publish further findings once verification is complete.
Members of the public with relevant information are invited to contact the Department.

media.caption: Recovered materials being registered at the Department's holding facility.
